experimental_method: Evaporated seawater in a 10 l thermostated reactor equilibrated with air bubbling; dissolved O2 of subsamples by whole-bottle Winkler titration (potentiometric endpoint), 8-35 C in 1 C steps, at least three measurements per T.
uncertainties_stated: Salinity accuracy +-0.001 permil (salinometer); no explicit uncertainty on the solubilities; agreement with Benson and Krause (1984) within 6 umol/kg (1.7 percent) below S = 40 permil.
quality_remarks: Equation fitted by the authors (Weiss-type with S^2 term, Table 2) not extracted. Pressure basis and kg basis not stated. Natural evaporated seawater, composition not quantified; HgCl2 fixative (1 mM) added to samples. Some columns are visibly irregular (see mapping notes). Authors note their values are higher than synthetic-NaCl results by up to -15 umol/kg difference at 133 permil (their statement).
not_extracted_tables: Table 2 (p. 162): fitted parameters of the authors' equation (model parameters)

row_counts.Table 1: printed 28 T rows x 11 salinities = 308 values; written 308 data rows plus 11 label rows

extraction_notes: Table is rotated on the page; text layer parsed by script; verified by viewing the page image and by an independent tesseract OCR of the rotated 300 dpi image, all 28 rows x 12 numbers identical. Sanity: T strictly decreasing in print order; solubility rises as T falls and falls as salinity rises except for the irregular entries noted. Salinity unit printed as per mille.
